toegepas.voor: Steek die prop in die muur en die ketel maak
toegepas.na: Steek die prop in die muur, en die ketel maak
toegepas.rede_vinder: The second clause has its own subject and verb (die ketel maak), so AWS 2017 puts a comma before en.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses: the imperative 'Steek die prop in die muur' and 'die ketel maak die water warm', which has its own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The second clause is a full sentence with its own subject, so the AWS 2017 comma belongs there, matching 'Die ketel staan vol water op die tafel, en niks gebeur nie' just before it.

toegepas.voor: die draadjies in die stof los
toegepas.na: die draadjies in die materiaal los
toegepas.rede_vinder: For a Grade 4 learner 'stof' first means dust; 'materiaal' is the clear everyday word for the fabric being ironed.
toegepas.fout: 'stof' is ambiguous for a Grade 4 science reader: it reads first as dust, and in this subject also as substance.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'materiaal' is the plain everyday word for the fabric being ironed and leaves the claim about heat loosening the threads unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Same reason as above, and keeps the two mentions of the fabric consistent.
toegepas.fout: Same ambiguity of 'stof' (dust, substance, fabric) in the next sentence.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Keeps the two mentions of the fabric consistent with change 2 and changes nothing the sentence says.

toegepas.blok: Nie alles kom uit as die deel wat ons wil hê nie
toegepas.voor: Dit gaan meestal as hitte weg waar
toegepas.na: Dit beland meestal as hitte waar
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'gaan weg' straight after 'raak nie weg nie' reads as a contradiction; 'beland' keeps the meaning without the clash.
toegepas.fout: 'gaan ... weg' straight after 'raak nie weg nie' reads to a Grade 4 learner as a contradiction of the point being made.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'beland' keeps the same claim, with 'meestal' and 'as hitte' intact, and removes the apparent clash that energy both does and does not go away.

vlae.blok: Wat in elkeen gaan en wat uitkom
vlae.teks: Die motor en die fiets: petrol, diesel of die ryer se energie gaan in, en beweging kom uit.
vlae.rede: Read literally, 'die ryer se energie' can attach to the motor as well as the bicycle; the pairing (petrol/diesel for the car, the rider for the bicycle) is only implied. Not changed, because splitting it would change the list item's content.

vlae.teks: Die strykyster kry sy energie deur 'n draad uit die muur. Sy uitset is hitte, en die hitte maak die draadjies in die stof los.
vlae.rede: 'draad' (the electric cord) and 'draadjies' (the fibres of the fabric) sit in adjacent sentences for two different things, which may confuse a Grade 4 reader. A different word for the fibres would be a vocabulary decision for the writer, so it is flagged, not changed.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: se gewig druk die los draadjies dan plat
laat_vaar_vorige.na: se gewig druk dan die los draadjies plat
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Dan sits more naturally straight after the verb, before the object.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Both word orders are natural Afrikaans, so this is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die energie lê al die tyd in daardie twee batterye gestoor
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Die energie is al die tyd in daardie twee batterye gestoor
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'lê ... gestoor' is wooden; the passive 'is ... gestoor' is the usual construction and keeps the meaning.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'lê ... gestoor' is a normal Afrikaans posture-verb construction that carries the sense of energy resting there unused; 'is gestoor' is a lateral move that flattens it.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: terug in dieselfde flitslig en druk weer
laat_vaar_vorige.na: terug in die flitslig en druk weer
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'dieselfde' occurs three times in two sentences; the flashlight is obviously the same one, and 'dieselfde twee batterye' and 'dieselfde liggie' still carry the point.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The repeated 'dieselfde' is deliberate emphasis in a test where only the batteries may change, and the original reads well, so cutting it is a lateral move that weakens the point.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Nie alles kom uit as die deel wat ons wil hê nie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'aan was' is colloquial; 'aangeskakel was' is the standard written form.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'aan was' for a lamp is plain, natural Afrikaans for a Grade 4 reader; 'aangeskakel was' is longer and only a lateral, more formal move.
